title: Tenma Saki — Profile Story

rows.Line: Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That was great, Ichi!
Next, it's my turn!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
It's great to meet you♪
I'm Saki Tenma, the keyboardist and sometimes songwriter for Leo/need!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I work really hard to write songs and put on performances that move people, so I hope you get a chance to listen to our stuff!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Now, for my self-intro...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ta-daa!
I'm gonna talk a little about songwriting!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I began writing songs because I wanted to do more for our band...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But it was a lot harder than I first expected. I had so much trouble coming up with anything good...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: After thinking it through a whole lot, I made a discovery! I realize now just how important it is to put everything you have into a song.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Which is why I made my first song for the people I really love! Everyone in Leo/need!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's meant to tell the people who listen to it that things are gonna be okay and encourage them to try again.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I felt so happy when I finished it because Ichi and the others were also really happy about it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But after that... I learned the hard way how those kinds of songs don't work for everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, I made my next one about empathy and understanding what someone might be going through...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: In order to write it, I dug really deep into my past to rediscover all the sad or tough things I experienced...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: By the time I'd finished writing it, I had something completely different from the songs I'd made before.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And it really hit home with the crowd!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's why I'm gonna keep taking really hard looks at myself when I write songs moving forward. I don't care how tough or painful it might be.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I wanna be there for everyone listening.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I wanna keep doing my best with the others from Leo/need, the people I really love!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
...is about what I have to say.
Did I do a good job?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. I totally did, right?
I've grown a ton since then, you know?!
